Hey, I'm Sarah! At about sixteen cents the Hammer Miner Thor P2 costs around $19 a month to run. It's $369, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: Adding to a setup: Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s, best value per TH, ships November 21; Harlo B30 $899, 30 TH/s, ships November 30.
Nice, so you know the drill. The T. P2 adds ten terahash for $369, about $19 a month in power. Will it mine in a pool or solo?
Looked up for Sarah: Pool mining pays out small and steady in Bitcoin straight to their own wallet, no exchange, no KYC — Thor P2 is quiet, about 40 dB.

Pool's a good fit. Sats go straight to your wallet. The T. ships October 3. For more hash per dollar, the Magic Miner 40T does forty terahash for $799 and ships November 21. (The call ended. 2 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
